about: A reading of British Library MS Sloane 3191, '48 Claves Angelicae', from the scan docs/998222247-Dee-MS-Sloane-3191.pdf.
Typed by hand from the page images in scratch/sloane-pages/ (ms/ for the manuscript pages, strips/ and zoom/ for the enlargements that were read).
It is one reading by eye and has not been confirmed by anyone. It changes no call file and nothing in calls/journal/.

A space is a clear gap between words. A hyphen is a stroke Dee draws under the line to tie two parts together. An underscore is a small gap with no tie: it may or may not be a word break, and it was judged by eye.
A '?' after a letter means that letter was not read with certainty. Accents are typed where they were seen and are not compared.

Only the places where the letters differ from the journal data were looked at again at full size. Words that agree were read once from the strips, so a reading that agrees may have been helped by knowing what to expect.
